model.name: Storm Watch shadow
model.identity: Storm Watch is an internal Young Power Radar for low-history hitters whose MLB power signal is forming before the track record exists.

score.definition: 60% Storm Fuel A2 + 20% Barrel/PA + 20% HR-Window Thunder/PA.
score.stormFuelA2: 50% stabilized xHR/BBE + 25% stabilized HR-Window Thunder Rate + 25% Air EV90.
score.airEv90: 90th-percentile EV on lifted damage-zone contact, launch angle 15-45 degrees.

stabilization.realPrior: xHR/BBE M=150, HR-Window Thunder Rate M=100.
stabilization.noPrior: xHR/Thunder shrink toward league average at M=317; Air EV90 shrinks toward current pool average at M=62 using air-BBE denominator.

buckets.earlyEmergenceBbe250: Early Emergence with BBE >= 250; stronger internal context only.

contextPolicy.emergenceScore: Secondary context only: B6-Air plus positive realized-HR lag, exposure novelty, and age runway.
contextPolicy.durability: Contact/whiff/chase/K/BB are confidence context only, not score inputs.
contextPolicy.consensusTodo: Future validation should compare surfaced names against public consensus/projection/prospect context to ask whether Storm Watch found useful names before the broader market did.
